t: An entry-level NXP microcontroller on a 15 dollar board with a built-in debugger.
steps: Buy the FRDM-MCXA153 board from NXP, Avnet, or Arrow.
Install VS Code with the MCUXpresso extension and SDK.
Plug the board into your computer with a USB-C cable on the debugger port.
Open the LED blinky example from the SDK.
Build and flash it, then watch the RGB LED blink.
Try the temperature sensor example next.
Install Zephyr and build its blinky sample for the frdm_mcxa153 board.
meta: Open Board. From $13.24. A few stores.
